skill.name: dev-agent-toolbox
skill.description: Choose and use browser-only developer utilities for API, JSON, URL, security-hygiene, and AI-agent workflow tasks while explaining their limitations.
skill.summary: Select browser-based developer utilities and interpret their results with clear privacy and security limitations.
skill.author: falconprojectai-arch

security_audit.summary: The hardcoded URL is a utility-selection reference, not an instruction to transmit sensitive data. The skill explicitly warns against submitting secrets to third-party sites. No evidence found of prompt injection or exfiltration intent; external utility behavior and privacy claims were not independently verified.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md:13 links to the described utility collection, while lines 14-16 require input guidance, warnings against sharing secrets, and accurate result interpretation. This supports a benign reference rather than exfiltration; it does not establish the external site's safety.

content.user_title: Choose Developer Utilities With Clear Safety Limits
content.value_statement: Small developer tasks require different utilities, and their results can be easy to misinterpret. This skill guides utility selection, input preparation, and cautious result interpretation.
actual_capabilities: Match JSON, URL, encoding, regex, and hashing tasks to the referenced browser utility collection.
Guide utility selection for retry calculations, rate limits, trace review, and text redaction.
Explain required inputs and whether an operation is reversible.
Warn against submitting production secrets or confidential payloads to third-party sites.
Interpret results while distinguishing JWT decoding from signature verification and token estimates from exact counts.
limitations: The skill contains guidance and an external link, not bundled utility implementations.
Browser-only processing and no-upload behavior are product documentation claims, not independently verified guarantees.
JWT decoding does not verify signatures or establish token authenticity.
Token estimates are approximate; heuristic helpers do not replace security audits or production-grade parsers.

use_cases.title: Inspect a Sample API Payload
use_cases.description: Select a JSON formatting utility and interpret a sanitized payload without treating formatting as schema validation.

use_cases.title: Review Retry Calculations
use_cases.description: Choose a retry or rate-limit calculator and explain its inputs and result boundaries.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Redacted Agent Trace
use_cases.description: Choose trace-review or text-redaction helpers and identify confidential content that must stay out of third-party tools.

prompt_templates.title: Select a JSON Utility
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a JSON formatting utility for this synthetic payload: [sample]. Explain the required input and what formatting does not verify.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: selecting a utility for one task.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Encoding Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to [encode or decode] this synthetic URL component: [sample]. Recommend a suitable utility and explain reversibility and input precautions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: preparing inputs and interpreting transformations.

prompt_templates.title: Interpret Retry Calculations
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me select a retry calculator for [synthetic scenario]. Explain required inputs, interpret the result, and distinguish calculations from production guarantees.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Agent Troubleshooting Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan utility selection for a sanitized agent trace, token estimate, and decoded JWT. Explain each input, privacy precaution, and verification limitation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinating several utilities without overstating their results.

output_examples.input: Which utility should I use to inspect a synthetic JWT?
output: Choose a JWT decoding utility to inspect the token contents.
Decoding does not verify the signature or establish authenticity.
Do not enter production tokens or confidential payloads into third-party sites.

output_examples.input: I need readable JSON from a sanitized test response. Does formatting prove it is suitable for production?
output: Choose a JSON formatting utility and provide only the sanitized test response.
Formatting improves readability but does not establish application-level correctness.
Use appropriate validation and production-grade parsers for production decisions.

best_practices: Use synthetic or sanitized inputs and keep production secrets out of third-party sites.
Identify the exact task and confirm the required inputs before choosing a utility.
Check each result against the utility's documented scope before relying on it.
anti_patterns: Pasting confidential payloads into a site because its documentation claims browser-only processing.
Treating a decoded JWT as proof of a valid signature.
Using token estimates or heuristic helpers as exact counts or security guarantees.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides instructions for choosing browser utilities, preparing inputs, and interpreting outputs. The utilities themselves are hosted externally.

faq.question: Which tasks does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers JSON formatting, URL parsing, encoding, decoding, regex testing, hashing, retry calculations, rate limits, trace review, and text redaction.

faq.question: Can I paste production secrets into the tools?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly warns against entering production secrets or confidential payloads into third-party sites.

faq.question: Are inputs guaranteed to remain in my browser?
faq.answer: The skill attributes browser-only processing and no uploads to product documentation. This audit did not independently verify those claims.

faq.question: Does JWT decoding verify the token?
faq.answer: No. Decoding does not verify signatures. Use appropriate cryptographic verification before trusting a token.

faq.question: Can these helpers replace exact measurements or security reviews?
faq.answer: No. Token estimates are approximate, and formatting, decoding, or heuristic helpers do not replace security audits or production-grade parsers.
